application:authorization-model:model.decision: Owner-only model: every Book, Rating, ReadingList and list entry belongs to one person (owner_id); every read and write checks owner_id against the signed-in person in one permission function; another person's ids answer 404. No roles. Neither source had any authorization (Shelfie's documented gateway auth does not exist in its code); this is needed because the user wants 'people' to keep libraries. Alternative not chosen: a single-person local app with no accounts.
application:authorization-model:model.note: pre-approved recommendation (benchmark operator); no live user

application:session:session.decision: Email and password sign-in (password hashed with the standard library's scrypt), server-side session stored in the database, random token in an http-only, SameSite=Lax cookie; sign out deletes the session. Shelfie's unused SHELFIE_SESSION_SECRET is not carried over.

database:entity-meaning:book.decision: Same thing: both are a 'books' table with integer id and required title, referenced the same way by ratings (and by Readr's list_books). Merge into one Book (id, owner_id, title required, author optional). Field origins listed in architecture.json.
database:entity-meaning:book.note: pre-approved recommendation (benchmark operator); evidence A-E01, B-E03

database:duplicate-entity:book.decision: Merge into one Book table holding title (A, B) and author (A only, nullable).

database:data-migration:existing-data-im.decision: Start the unified app with an empty database; no import of shelfie.db or readr.db in this plan (none was provided; whether real data exists is unknown). If the user has data, an import that re-keys Readr's ids is planned separately with templates/migration-plan.md, a backup and a dry run, and needs its own migration approval.
database:data-migration:existing-data-im.note: plan approved; any future import needs its own approval

application:business-rule:rating-scale.decision: Integer 1-5 'stars', enforced on the server and by a database CHECK; anything else is 400. The 1-10 'score' scale in Shelfie's old docs is not used.

application:business-rule:export-format.decision: JSON export only ([{title, stars}] for the signed-in person's books); no CSV.

application:business-rule:rating-cardina.decision: One rating per person per book (unique (owner, book)); rating again replaces it; a rating can be cleared.

database:data-integrity:write-persistenc.decision: Commit every write; PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON on every connection; deleting a book removes its rating and list entries (cascade); data survives a restart.

api:api-shape:path-version-prefix.decision: Use /api/... without a version prefix, as Shelfie's code does.

migration:book.decision: Low risk: the unified Book adds author (nullable) and owner_id; applies to a fresh database only (no import, see existing-data-import).
migration:book.note: plan only; nothing is migrated in plan mode
